1879073393.name: Scourging Blow
1879073393.desc: A melee attack dealing additional damage if the enemy suffers from Barbed Arrow.\n\nUsing this skill will stop the bleeding.

1879112561.name: Feint Attack
1879112561.desc: A quick feint attack misdirects your foe, briefly allowing your next attack to act as though you are attacking from stealth.

1879153777.name: Enhanced Gash
1879153777.desc: A deep cutting strike. This strike stuns your target.

1879157617.name: Chilling Winds
1879157617.desc: A weak AOE tactical attack that slows move and attack speed.

1879191025.name: Righteousness Arrow
1879191025.desc: These arrows will make servants of the Eye burn, fearing as they do the goodness of the Dúnedain.

1879191793.name: Warrior
1879191793.desc: Call upon your Soldier to assist you in battle, who has trained as a Warrior.\n<rgb=#FF0000>Can only be used inside of a Skirmish. Can be used while in combat.</rgb>

1879208433.name: Green-clad Horse of the Gap
1879208433.desc: A horse bearing a horse emblem in green barding.

1879214577.name: Adroit Manoeuvre
1879214577.desc: A strike that lets the Warden attack more quickly for a time.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879234289.name: Split Shot: Shafts of Light
1879234289.desc: Looses multiple arrows at once, hitting several targets in a small area.\n\nArrows inflict Light damage.

1879248369.name: Seeking Arrow - Fire
1879248369.desc: Steadying your mount, you attempt a well-placed shot at an enemy that will deal Fire-based damage and apply a potentially harmful effect to your target.

1879250033.name: Clash of Arms
1879250033.desc: Using superior tactics, you deal very little damage to a target but assess the enemy so well that you gain a significant advantage over your foe.

1879272177.name: Healer's Strike
1879272177.desc: A melee attack that increases healing effects on yourself for a short time.\n\nRestores Morale of the Fellowship.

1879273073.name: Bastion of Light
1879273073.desc: Your connexion to the Light manifests beneath your feet; marking targets within the light making them susceptible to your debuffs.

1879301233.name: Guide to Aldburg
1879301233.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Aldburg in western Rohan.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879315825.name: Serrated Edge
1879315825.desc: A vicious, single strike that leaves your enemy bleeding.

1879320177.name: Steed of the Ship-kings
1879320177.desc: A horse from the defenders of Pelargir.

1879352177.name: Steed of the Ash Plains
1879352177.desc: A steed clad in the raiment of the Ash Plains.

1879392113.name: Steed of the Minas Ithil Hero
1879392113.desc: A steed granted to those who braved the trials of the lost city.

1879396209.name: Steed of the Morgul Victor
1879396209.desc: This steed bears trophies from your hardest fought victories in Minas Morgul.

1879410033.name: Guide to Annâk-khurfu
1879410033.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Annâk-khurfu in Elderslade.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879410801.name: Sporting Steed
1879410801.desc: A steed with minimal trappings, perfect for navigating dense forests and jumping obstacles.

1879418737.name: Finely Wrought Carrying Torch
1879418737.desc: Carry around a finely wrought torch to light your way.

1879428081.name: Take a Breath
1879428081.desc: Rest so that you may rejoin the fight with renewed fury. Restores a small amount of Morale and places a damage boost on the Brawler.

1879449841.name: Vigilant Roar (Dual)
1879449841.desc: You fiercely cry out at an enemy.

1879463025.name: Spiky Avanc
1879463025.desc: Summons a spiky avanc to accompany you on your journeys.

1879467249.name: The South Wind
1879467249.desc: Sing to the South Wind, which helps to quicken the pace of you and your allies.

1879470577.name: Explosive Brew
1879470577.desc: A pot filled with combustible substances and set alight.

1879494129.name: Guise of the Witch-king of Angmar
1879494129.desc: A finely-crafted costume in the guise of the Witch-king of Angmar. Be careful not to bump into any daggers of Westernesse!

1879497713.name: Sign of the Wild: Protection
1879497713.desc: Command your pet to use a defensive ability, prioritizing survival above all else.

1879521393.name: Stone Mûmak Calf
1879521393.desc: Summons a stone mûmak calf to accompany you on your travels.
